540  H5F_get_checksums(const uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_size, uint32_t *s_chksum /*out*/, uint32_t *c_chksum /*out*/)

   542      FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI_NOINIT_NOERR
   543
   544      /* Check arguments */
   545      HDassert(buf);
   546      HDassert(buf_size);
   547
   548      /* Return the stored checksum */
   549      if (s_chksum) {
   550          const uint8_t *chk_p; /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
   551
   552          /* Offset to the checksum in the buffer */
   553          chk_p = buf + buf_size - H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM;
   554
   555          /* Decode the checksum stored in the buffer */
   556          UINT32DECODE(chk_p, *s_chksum);
   557      } /* end if */
   558
   559      /* Return the computed checksum for the buffer */
   560      if (c_chksum)
   561          *c_chksum = H5_checksum_metadata(buf, buf_size - H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM, 0);
   562
   563      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(SUCCEED)
   564  } /* end H5F_get_chksums() */

   228  static htri_t
   229  H5O__cache_verify_chksum(const void *_image, size_t len, void *_udata)
   230  {
   231      const uint8_t  *image     = (const uint8_t *)_image;  /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
   232      H5O_cache_ud_t *udata     = (H5O_cache_ud_t *)_udata; /* User data for callback */
   233      htri_t          ret_value = TRUE;                     /* Return value */
   234
   235      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE_NOERR
   236
   237      /* Check arguments */
   238      HDassert(image);
   239      HDassert(udata);
   240      HDassert(udata->oh);
   241
   242      /* There is no checksum for version 1 */
   243      if (udata->oh->version != H5O_VERSION_1) {
   244          uint32_t stored_chksum;   /* Stored metadata checksum value */
   245          uint32_t computed_chksum; /* Computed metadata checksum value */
   246
   247          /* Get stored and computed checksums */
   248          H5F_get_checksums(image, len, &stored_chksum, &computed_chksum);
   249
   250          if (stored_chksum != computed_chksum) {
   251              /* These fields are not deserialized yet in H5O__prefix_deserialize() */
   252              HDassert(udata->oh->chunk == NULL);
   253              HDassert(udata->oh->mesg == NULL);
   254              HDassert(udata->oh->proxy == NULL);
   255
   256              /* Indicate that udata->oh is to be freed later
   257                 in H5O__prefix_deserialize() */
   258              udata->free_oh = TRUE;
   259              ret_value      = FALSE;
   260          } /* end if */
   261      }     /* end if */
   262      else
   263          HDassert(!(udata->common.file_intent & H5F_ACC_SWMR_WRITE));
   264
   265      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   266  } /* end H5O__cache_verify_chksum() */
